BAGELSMOD-IMPROVISE.title: Improvise
BAGELSMOD-IMPROVISE.description: Add {Cards:diff()} random [gold]Unupgraded[/gold] cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] them.
BAGELSMOD-SLIP.title: Slip
BAGELSMOD-ALL_OUT.title: All Out
BAGELSMOD-ALL_OUT.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
You can no longer gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards.
BAGELSMOD-OBSESSION.title: Obsession
BAGELSMOD-OBSESSION.description: If [gold]Exhausted[/gold] or in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of your turn, add an [red]Obsession[/red] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-PRESERVED_VINES.title: Preserved Vines
BAGELSMOD-PRESERVED_VINES.description:
Can be dissolved at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
Strengthen vines by [blue]{ThornsIncrement}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingIncrement}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
(Currently [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] and [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold])
BAGELSMOD-MYSTERIOUS_SEED.title: Mysterious Seed
BAGELSMOD-MYSTERIOUS_SEED.description:
Can be grown by defeating an [gold]Elite[/gold].
Nurture fruit by [blue]{GoldIncrement}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and [blue]{MaxHpIncrement}[/blue] Max HP.
(Currently [blue]{Gold:diff()}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and [blue]{MaxHp:diff()}[/blue] Max HP)
BAGELSMOD-ENDLESS_TROVE.title: Endless Trove
BAGELSMOD-ENDLESS_TROVE.description:
Can be [gold]Removed[/gold] to obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold] for each time this has been played this run.
(Currently {Relics} [gold]Relics[/gold])
